Storefront and customer routes of the cart module. Send `Accept-Language` (or `X-Locale` from a browser) on every call; a customer route needs the session cookie.

## DELETE /v1/cart

Clear shopping cart

Responses:

- `204`: Cart cleared.

## GET /v1/cart

Get shopping cart

Responses:

- `200`: Cart retrieved.

## DELETE /v1/cart/coupon

Remove coupon from cart

Responses:

- `200`: Coupon removed.

## POST /v1/cart/coupon

Apply coupon code

Request body: [ApplyCouponDto](#applycoupondto).

Responses:

- `200`: Coupon applied.
- `400`: Invalid coupon.

## GET /v1/cart/estimate

Estimate shipping cost

Parameters:

- `country` in query (string, pattern `/^[A-Z]{2}$/`, min length 2, max length 2, required).
- `postalCode` in query (string, min length 3, max length 10, optional).

Responses:

- `200`: Shipping estimate retrieved.
- `400`: Invalid input.

## DELETE /v1/cart/gift-card

Remove gift card from cart

Responses:

- `204`: Gift card removed.

## POST /v1/cart/gift-card

Apply gift card

Request body: [ApplyGiftCardDto](#applygiftcarddto).

Responses:

- `200`: Gift card applied; returns the updated cart.
- `400`: Invalid gift card.

## POST /v1/cart/items

Add item to cart

Request body: [AddItemDto](#additemdto).

Responses:

- `200`: Item added.
- `400`: Invalid input.
- `404`: Variant not found.

## DELETE /v1/cart/items/{itemId}

Remove cart item

Parameters:

- `itemId` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `200`: Item removed.
- `404`: Item not found.

## PATCH /v1/cart/items/{itemId}

Update cart item

Parameters:

- `itemId` in path (string, required).

Request body: [UpdateItemDto](#updateitemdto).

Responses:

- `200`: Item updated.
- `400`: Invalid input.
- `404`: Item not found.

## POST /v1/cart/items/{itemId}/save-for-later

Save item for later

Parameters:

- `itemId` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `200`: Item saved.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `404`: Item not found.

## POST /v1/cart/merge

Merge the anonymous cart into the signed-in cart

Responses:

- `200`: Merged cart returned.
- `401`: Unauthorized.

## Schemas

### AddItemDto

- `variantId` (string, required).
- `quantity` (number, min 1, required).

### ApplyCouponDto

- `code` (string, pattern `/^[A-Z0-9_-]+$/i`, max length 50, required).

### ApplyGiftCardDto

- `code` (string, pattern `/^[A-Z0-9]+$/`, min length 8, max length 20, required).

### UpdateItemDto

- `quantity` (number, min 1, required).
